provenance.review: machine-checked by lab.tools.check_registry (verbatim quotes, sections, ids); content reviewed by Claude where noted in review_notes

draft_notes: Only the supplied text was used. The supplied prefix contains a carriage return, represented as \r in requirement ids. Main-text provisions use their printed clause numbers; appendix provisions use their containing appendix headings, including A.1a. Unnumbered headings retain their title text. Closely related fields or conjunctive conditions are grouped where they define one contract or rule. Narrative aspirations and asserted historical measurements are not independently treated as obligations. The text leaves conflicts unresolved between algorithm immutability and calibration/upgrades, simultaneous biosphere Kill Switch activation and Mercy suspension, stake burning and redistribution, and six-node signatures versus the additional Wild Node. The phrase 'grows exponentially' conflicts with the explicit quadratic formula. The Genesis example contains comments, abbreviated cryptographic values, and an empty signature placeholder, so it is not a complete executable JSON block or verifiable cryptographic artifact. Referenced DKP documents were not supplied.

requirements.title: Public Algorithmic Governance Requirements
requirements.quote:
- Open and immutable algorithms,
- Public metrics and transparent data,
- Automated liability procedures,
requirements.interpretation: Check algorithm accessibility and change history, metric and data publication, and automated liability execution. The text does not define openness, transparency, or the permitted relationship between immutability and later parameter changes.
requirements.criterion: Governance algorithms are open and immutable, metrics are public, data are transparent, and liability procedures are automated.
requirements.gap: Operational definitions of openness, transparency, and immutability are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define publication and transparency tests.
Define which changes are compatible with immutability.

requirements.title: Algorithms Excluded From Subjecthood
requirements.quote: Algorithms define binding decision rules and execution constraints, but do not constitute Subjects and do not bear causal or legal responsibility.
requirements.interpretation: Check that algorithmic rules are binding while algorithms are excluded from Subject and responsibility assignments. Identifying algorithms and Subjects requires a classification scheme.
requirements.criterion: Algorithms define binding rules and constraints but are never classified as Subjects or assigned causal or legal responsibility.
requirements.gap: The text does not provide operational entity classifications or a test of binding force. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define algorithm classification and how binding rules are represented.

requirements.title: Originating Subjects Retain Responsibility
requirements.quote: All responsibility for the deployment, funding, and effects of algorithmic execution remains fully attributable to the originating Subjects, as defined in DKP-1-IDENTITY-001.
requirements.interpretation: Check that responsibility for deployment, funding, and execution effects is fully assigned to originating Subjects. Subject identity and attribution cannot be resolved from this document alone.
requirements.criterion: All responsibility for algorithm deployment, funding, and effects is attributable to originating Subjects.
requirements.gap: The referenced identity specification and responsibility attribution procedure are absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how originating Subjects and shared responsibility are determined.

requirements.title: Justice Function Political Independence
requirements.quote: The function δίκη is appointed by no one and can never be altered by the will of those in power.
requirements.interpretation: Audit the origin and authorization of changes to the justice function. Whether a change expresses the will of those in power requires an external decision model.
requirements.criterion: No person appoints δίκη, and no alteration is made by the will of those in power.
requirements.gap: Appointment and alteration by political will are not operationally defined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define prohibited appointment and political-control relationships.

requirements.title: Justice Function Axiomatic Basis
requirements.quote: Derived from predefined axioms, such as:
requirements.interpretation: The justice function is to derive from predefined axioms, illustrated by reciprocal harm acceptance, avoidance of unnecessary and non-compensable suffering, sustainability maximization, nature preservation, and truth and transparency priority. The phrase 'such as' leaves the axiom set open, and no formal derivation or conflict resolution is supplied.
requirements.criterion: δίκη is derived from predefined axioms consistent with the listed principles.
requirements.gap: The axiom set, formal meanings, and rules for resolving conflicts between principles are undefined.
hypotheses_needed: Formalize the axioms and whether the examples are individually mandatory.
Define harm acceptance, avoidable suffering, sustainability, preservation, and priority.

requirements.title: Open Consensus Calibration Participation
requirements.quote: And is constantly calibrated by an open consensus mechanism, where participation is distributed according to competence, reputation, and proven accuracy.
requirements.interpretation: Check that calibration uses an open consensus process and that participation depends on all three named attributes. No cadence, weighting formula, or reconciliation with A.1a's ban on continuous parameter adjustment is given.
requirements.criterion: δίκη is constantly calibrated through open consensus with participation distributed according to competence, reputation, and proven accuracy.
data_dependencies: participant competence, reputation, and accuracy records
requirements.gap: Calibration cadence and participation allocation rules are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define 'constantly' and the participation allocation function.
Declare how this calibration differs from prohibited continuous Equation adjustment.

requirements.title: Damage Automatically Generates Liability
requirements.quote: - A self-regulating political system, where damage automatically generates liability;
requirements.interpretation: Check that each recognized damage event automatically creates liability. Recognition, attribution, and the extent of liability require additional definitions.
requirements.criterion: Every damage event automatically generates liability.
requirements.gap: Damage recognition and liability attribution rules are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define qualifying damage events and automatic liability creation.

requirements.title: Profit Linked To Social Benefit
requirements.quote: - A self-auditing economic system, where a subject's profit is mathematically linked to society's benefit;
requirements.interpretation: A check would evaluate the mathematical relationship between Subject profit and social benefit. Neither the benefit measure nor the linking function is supplied.
requirements.criterion: A mathematical relationship links each subject's profit to society's benefit.
requirements.gap: The benefit measure and profit-benefit relationship are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the social benefit measure and linking function.

requirements.title: Lies Must Be Economically Unprofitable
requirements.quote: - A self-correcting information system, where lies are economically unprofitable;
requirements.interpretation: Compare the economic gains and costs of lying under a declared behavior and enforcement model. The text does not specify whether unprofitability applies to every realized lie or expected returns.
requirements.criterion: Lies are economically unprofitable.
requirements.gap: Lie classification, accounting horizon, and realized-versus-expected profitability are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define lying, economic return, and the evaluation horizon.
Choose realized or expected unprofitability.

requirements.title: Nature Exploitation Requires Invisible Impact
requirements.quote: - A self-sustaining ecological system, where the exploitation of nature is permitted only within the framework of invisible impact.
requirements.interpretation: Check that every permitted exploitation activity satisfies an invisible-impact condition. The preamble does not define that condition; Article 13 gives a narrower surface-integrity rule for reserves.
requirements.criterion: Nature exploitation is permitted only within invisible impact.
requirements.gap: Invisible impact is undefined for the general scope of nature exploitation. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define invisible impact and whether Article 13's surface-integrity test applies outside reserves.

requirements.title: Separate Basic And Venture Circuits
requirements.quote: 1.1. The global economy is divided into two independent circuits: Basic (consumption, resources, land) and Venture (space, fundamental science, AI).
requirements.interpretation: Check economic classification into Basic and Venture and their independence. Mixed activities and permitted interactions between the circuits are not defined.
requirements.criterion: The economy has two independent circuits with the listed Basic and Venture domains.
requirements.gap: Independence and classification of mixed or unlisted activities are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define circuit independence and classification rules.

requirements.title: Basic Circuit Development Growth Peg
requirements.quote: 1.2. Law of Dynamic Standard (Mirror Peg): The value of currencies and assets in the Basic circuit of developed nations is rigidly pegged to the 5-year moving average of economic growth in the bottom 20% of countries (Development Quintile).
requirements.interpretation: Compute the specified moving average after identifying the Development Quintile, then test the peg. Country ranking, growth aggregation, developed-nation classification, and the conversion from growth to asset values are missing.
requirements.criterion: Basic-circuit currencies and assets of developed nations are rigidly pegged to the 5-year moving average of economic growth in the bottom 20% of countries.
requirements.gap: The ranking basis, aggregation method, and numerical peg function are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define quintile membership, country weighting, moving-average sampling, and the peg function.

requirements.title: Venture Exemption And Disclosure Pledge
requirements.quote: 1.3. Venture Gateway: Capital in the Venture circuit is exempt from the Mirror Peg and taxes, provided the "Open Tech Pledge" is signed — requiring the release of developments to the public domain after 5 years.
requirements.interpretation: Check that exemptions depend on a signed pledge and that covered developments enter the public domain after five years. The event starting that period is not given here; patent registration appears in 4.1 but is not expressly imported.
requirements.criterion: Signed Open Tech Pledge permits Venture capital exemption from taxes and the Mirror Peg and requires public-domain release after 5 years.
requirements.gap: The five-year clock origin, scope of developments, and consequences of breach are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define the clock origin and developments covered by each pledge.

requirements.title: Regional Decline Triggers Snap Protocol
requirements.quote: 1.4. Snap Protocol (Emergency Transparency): In the event of a sharp drop (more than 10% per month) in indicators in any region (war, repression), smoothing is disabled, and the aggressor's quotes in the Basic circuit crash instantly.
requirements.interpretation: Detect a monthly indicator decline exceeding ten percent, then check smoothing disablement and the aggressor's immediate quote decline. The indicators, aggressor attribution, and crash magnitude are undefined.
requirements.criterion: A regional indicator drop greater than 10% per month disables smoothing and instantly crashes the aggressor's Basic-circuit quotes.
requirements.gap: Indicator selection, decline calculation, crash magnitude, and instant-execution semantics are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define qualifying indicators, aggressor attribution, and crash behavior.
Specify interaction with Mercy suspension.

requirements.title: Global Financing Through Targeted Contracts
requirements.quote: 2.1. Financing from global funds is carried out exclusively through targeted smart contracts.
requirements.interpretation: Check that every financing transaction from a global fund executes through a smart contract with a declared target. The meaning of a qualifying target is not specified.
requirements.criterion: Every global-fund financing transaction uses a targeted smart contract.
requirements.gap: The scope of global funds and the required targeting semantics are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define the global-fund registry and qualifying contract targets.

requirements.title: Verified KPIs Gate Tranche Unlocking
requirements.quote: 2.2. Funds are unlocked algorithmically (in tranches) only upon the completion of physically verifiable KPIs (built, cured, educated).
requirements.interpretation: Check that each algorithmic tranche unlock follows completion of the relevant physically verifiable KPI. KPI definitions and evidence acceptance are external inputs.
requirements.criterion: Funds unlock algorithmically in tranches only when the corresponding physically verifiable KPIs are complete.
requirements.gap: KPI completion criteria and tranche-to-KPI mappings are not supplied. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare KPI verification rules and tranche mappings.

requirements.title: Raw Exports Require Chain Participation
requirements.quote: 3.1. Direct export of raw materials is permitted only if the exporter participates in the value-added chain.
requirements.interpretation: Check chain participation before permitting a direct raw-material export. The qualifying form or extent of participation is unspecified.
requirements.criterion: Every permitted direct raw-material export has an exporter participating in the value-added chain.
requirements.gap: Qualifying value-added-chain participation is undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define participation and the relevant value-added chain.

requirements.title: Exporting Countries Receive Processing Equity
requirements.quote: 3.2. The resource-exporting country automatically receives equity tokens (shares) in the processing enterprises using this resource, regardless of their geography.
requirements.interpretation: Trace exported resources to processing enterprises and check automatic equity allocation to the exporting country. The share quantity and allocation timing are missing; 3.3 describes the intended downstream profit consequence.
requirements.criterion: Each resource-exporting country automatically receives equity in enterprises processing its resource, without a geographic restriction.
requirements.gap: Equity amounts, resource tracing rules, and allocation timing are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define the equity allocation function and resource provenance model.

requirements.title: Mandatory Technology Public Domain Transition
requirements.quote: 4.1. Any technology necessary for life support or created within the preferential Venture circuit enters the Public Domain 5 years after patent registration.
requirements.interpretation: For technology meeting either eligibility condition, check public-domain entry five years after patent registration. Unpatented technologies have no specified clock origin.
requirements.criterion: Life-support technology or technology created within the preferential Venture circuit enters the Public Domain 5 years after patent registration.
requirements.gap: Life-support necessity and treatment of unpatented technology are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define life-support necessity and treatment of technology lacking patent registration.

requirements.title: Planetary Competence And Diploma Recognition
requirements.quote: 5.1. A single planetary standard of competence is introduced. Diplomas are confirmed by passing a standardized AI exam and are recognized in all jurisdictions.
requirements.interpretation: Check use of a common competence standard, exam-based diploma confirmation, and recognition across jurisdictions. The standard, exam, and pass requirements are not supplied.
requirements.criterion: One planetary competence standard applies; passing the standardized AI exam confirms diplomas, which all jurisdictions recognize.
requirements.gap: The competence standard and exam specification are absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the common exam, pass criteria, and recognition test.

requirements.title: Absolute Right To Leave Jurisdictions
requirements.quote: 6.1. Right to Exit: Citizens have the absolute right to leave any jurisdiction.
requirements.interpretation: Check that citizens face no jurisdictional restriction on leaving. The text does not define how to distinguish a prohibited restriction from a practical inability to travel.
requirements.criterion: Every citizen has an unrestricted right to leave any jurisdiction.
requirements.gap: An operational test of an absolute exit right is missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define which policies and actions constitute restrictions on exit.

requirements.title: Funded Relocation From Depressed Zones
requirements.quote: Relocation costs from depressed zones are covered by a global fund.
requirements.interpretation: Check that the global fund covers qualifying relocation costs for departures from depressed zones. Neither zone eligibility nor eligible cost categories are defined.
requirements.criterion: A global fund covers relocation costs from depressed zones.
requirements.gap: Depressed-zone classification and covered-cost rules are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define depressed zones and covered relocation costs.

requirements.title: Annual Specialist Relocation Lease Fee
requirements.quote: 6.2. Talent Leasing: Upon the relocation of a specialist, the recipient country pays an annual commission (Lease Fee) to the donor country.
requirements.interpretation: Check that specialist relocation establishes an annual payment obligation from the recipient country to the donor country. Amount, duration, and the relation between donor-country entitlement and the Education Fund destination in 6.4 are not fully specified.
requirements.criterion: Specialist relocation entails an annual Lease Fee paid by the recipient country to the donor country.
requirements.gap: Fee calculation, specialist eligibility, and obligation duration are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define specialist eligibility, fee calculation, and payment duration.

requirements.title: Successful Work Precedes Lease Payment
requirements.quote: 6.3. Post-Factum Principle: Payment is made only after a year of successful work by the specialist, preventing the creation of "fake diploma factories."
requirements.interpretation: Check that payment does not occur before a year of successful specialist work. The success criterion and whether this gate repeats for every annual payment are unspecified.
requirements.criterion: A Lease Fee payment occurs only after a year of successful work by the specialist.
requirements.gap: Successful work and application of the gate to recurring payments are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define successful work and whether each payment requires a separate successful year.

requirements.title: Lease Revenue Education Fund Destination
requirements.quote: 6.4. Educational DAO: Lease funds do not go to the government budget but to a transparent Education Fund in the region of origin.
requirements.interpretation: Check payment destinations and fund transparency. The region-of-origin rule and transparency standard require interpretation.
requirements.criterion: Lease funds enter a transparent Education Fund in the region of origin and never the government budget.
requirements.gap: Region of origin and fund transparency are not operationally defined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define origin assignment and transparency requirements.

requirements.title: Trade Access Requires Proportional Stake
requirements.quote: 7.1. To access the Global Trade Network, a state deposits a pledge (Stake) into an Escrow smart contract. The stake size is proportional to GDP.
requirements.interpretation: Check a state's escrow deposit before trade access and compare the stake with GDP using a declared proportionality coefficient. The coefficient and GDP reference period are missing.
requirements.criterion: Trade access requires an Escrow smart-contract Stake whose size is proportional to the state's GDP.
requirements.gap: The stake-to-GDP coefficient and GDP measurement convention are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the proportionality coefficient and GDP reference period.

requirements.title: Peaceful States Accrue Growth Dividends
requirements.quote: 7.2. As long as the state maintains peace, dividends from global GDP growth accrue on the stake.
requirements.interpretation: Check dividend accrual during intervals classified as peaceful. The dividend formula and treatment of zero or negative global growth are unspecified.
requirements.criterion: While a state maintains peace, dividends from global GDP growth accrue on its Stake.
requirements.gap: Peace classification and dividend calculation are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define peaceful intervals and dividend accrual, including nonpositive growth.

requirements.title: Aggression Automatically Burns Peace Stake
requirements.quote: 7.3. In the event of aggression, the stake is automatically burned (Slashing).
requirements.interpretation: Given an aggression determination, check automatic destruction of the state's stake. Aggression detection and the execution deadline are not defined here.
requirements.criterion: Aggression automatically causes the aggressor's Stake to be burned.
requirements.gap: Aggression classification and automatic-execution timing are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define aggression recognition and the execution event.

requirements.title: Aggression Or Exhaustion Triggers Disconnection
requirements.quote: 8.1. In the event of military aggression recorded by independent monitoring, or upon exhaustion of the Peace Stake, the violating region is automatically disconnected from the global financial, energy, and logistical infrastructure.
requirements.interpretation: Check automatic disconnection from all three infrastructure categories when either trigger occurs. Monitoring independence and the extent of regional disconnection need operational definitions.
requirements.criterion: Independently recorded military aggression or Peace Stake exhaustion automatically disconnects the violating region from global financial, energy, and logistical infrastructure.
requirements.gap: Independent monitoring, violating-region assignment, and complete disconnection are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define accepted monitoring and regional disconnection.
Specify interaction with Mercy suspension.

requirements.title: Weapon Damage Tenfold Asset Writeoff
requirements.quote: 8.2. The use of weapons entails the write-off of the aggressor's assets in an amount 10 times the damage caused.
requirements.interpretation: Given a weapons-use event, attributed aggressor, and damage value, compare the required write-off with ten times that value. Damage valuation and insufficient-asset handling are not specified.
requirements.criterion: The aggressor's asset write-off equals 10 × damage caused by weapons use.
requirements.gap: The document supplies no damage valuation or insufficient-assets procedure. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define damage valuation, attribution, and treatment of asset shortfalls.

requirements.title: Removable Regional Operator Governance
requirements.quote: 9.1. The institution of irremovable power is abolished. Territories are managed by Regional Operators.
requirements.interpretation: Check that territory management is assigned to Regional Operators and that no governing office has irremovable authority. Removal must be defined beyond merely naming a termination mechanism.
requirements.criterion: Territories are managed by Regional Operators, and no institution of irremovable power exists.
requirements.gap: The scope of power and the operational meaning of removability are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define governing offices and an effective removability test.

requirements.title: KPI Bound Operator Contract Termination
requirements.quote: 9.2. An Operator is hired for the duration of a specific KPI. Failure to meet the KPI leads to automatic contract termination.
requirements.interpretation: Check that each Operator contract is tied to a specific KPI duration and automatically terminates upon KPI failure. The document does not define how KPI duration or failure is determined.
requirements.criterion: Operator employment lasts for a specific KPI's duration, and KPI failure automatically terminates the contract.
requirements.gap: KPI duration, evaluation, and failure criteria are external to the text. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare KPI deadlines and failure conditions.

requirements.title: Public Real Time Budget Disclosure
requirements.quote: 10.1. All state/regional budget transactions are displayed on a public blockchain in real-time. Secret expenditure items are prohibited.
requirements.interpretation: Reconcile budget transactions and expenditure items with public blockchain records. A latency convention is needed to test real-time publication.
requirements.criterion: Every state or regional budget transaction is publicly displayed on a blockchain in real time, and no expenditure item is secret.
requirements.gap: Real-time latency and sufficient disclosure of expenditure items are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define real-time publication and disclosure completeness.

requirements.title: Covert Capital Interaction Criminal Classification
requirements.quote: 11.1. Any covert interaction of private capital with legislative algorithms or operators is a criminal offense.
requirements.interpretation: Check that every qualifying interaction is classified as a criminal offense. Detecting covert interaction and identifying private-capital influence require definitions and evidence.
requirements.criterion: Any covert interaction between private capital and legislative algorithms or operators is classified as a criminal offense.
requirements.gap: Covert interaction and private-capital participation are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define qualifying interactions, disclosure, and capital affiliations.

requirements.title: Prices Include Complete Environmental Costs
requirements.quote: 12.1. The cost of full disposal and environmental damage restoration is algorithmically included in the price of any good.
requirements.interpretation: Check that each good's price calculation includes full disposal and restoration costs. The text supplies no method for estimating either cost or separating them from other price components.
requirements.criterion: Every good's price algorithm includes its full disposal cost and environmental damage restoration cost.
requirements.gap: Full disposal and environmental restoration valuation methods are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare lifecycle boundaries and environmental cost estimation methods.

requirements.title: Forty Percent Biosphere Reserve Coverage
requirements.quote: 13.1. 40% of land is declared a Biosphere Reserve.
requirements.interpretation: Calculate declared reserve land area divided by total land area and compare with forty percent. The text says forty percent rather than a minimum; boundary and denominator conventions require data.
requirements.criterion: reserve_land_area / total_land_area = 40%.
requirements.gap: No lab check implemented yet.

requirements.title: Reserve Extraction Surface Integrity Requirement
requirements.quote: 13.2. Invisible Extraction: Resource extraction in reserves is permitted exclusively by methods that do not disturb the surface layer integrity (robotized tunnels, bio-leaching). Open pits and logging are prohibited.
requirements.interpretation: Check that reserve extraction preserves surface-layer integrity and excludes open pits and logging. The named methods are examples, not an express exhaustive whitelist; the geographic scope of the last sentence could be reserve-only or general.
requirements.criterion: Reserve extraction does not disturb surface-layer integrity; open pits and logging are prohibited.
requirements.gap: Surface integrity and the scope of the open-pit and logging prohibition are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define a surface-integrity test.
Declare whether the categorical bans apply only within reserves.

requirements.title: Reserve Residents Receive Sensor Based Income
requirements.quote: 13.3. Residents of reserves receive the status of Biosphere Operators. Their income is generated by a smart contract based on sensor data (biomass index, CO2 levels, biodiversity).
requirements.interpretation: Check Biosphere Operator status for reserve residents and sensor-dependent smart-contract income. Residency and the income function are undefined.
requirements.criterion: Reserve residents are Biosphere Operators whose income is generated by a smart contract based on biomass, CO2, and biodiversity sensor data.
requirements.gap: Residency eligibility and the sensor-to-income function are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define residency and the income calculation.

requirements.title: Decentralized Verification Of Official Statements
requirements.quote: 14.1. Public statements by officials are verified by a decentralized network of validators.
requirements.interpretation: Check that public official statements receive verification from a qualifying validator network. Statement scope, verification completion, and decentralization are undefined.
requirements.criterion: Public statements by officials are verified by a decentralized validator network.
requirements.gap: The text lacks statement coverage, verification, and decentralization criteria. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define covered statements and a decentralized verification procedure.

requirements.title: Quadratic Validator Vote Purchase Cost
requirements.quote: 14.2. Quadratic Protection: The cost of buying validator votes grows exponentially (Cost = Votes²), making a capital attack economically impossible.
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate Cost = Votes² using consistently represented quantities. The explicit formula is quadratic, despite the prose saying exponential; the claimed impossibility of a capital attack does not follow from a specified attack model.
requirements.criterion: Cost = Votes².
requirements.gap: No lab check implemented yet.

requirements.title: Domain Reputation Weights Validator Votes
requirements.quote: 14.3. Competence Weight: A validator's vote is weighted by their reputation in a specific field of knowledge (EigenTrust algorithm).
requirements.interpretation: Check that vote weighting uses reputation for the relevant knowledge field through EigenTrust. The document gives no EigenTrust implementation or domain-assignment rule.
requirements.criterion: Each validator vote is weighted using the validator's reputation in the specific knowledge field through EigenTrust.
requirements.gap: The EigenTrust calculation and mapping from reputation to vote weight are absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the EigenTrust implementation and field-to-vote mapping.

requirements.title: Influential Algorithms Require Open Source
requirements.quote: 15.1. The source code of all algorithms influencing resource allocation, social rating, or news feeds must be Open Source.
requirements.interpretation: Identify algorithms influencing any listed function and check their source-code status. The influence boundary and qualifying Open Source standard are not defined.
requirements.criterion: All algorithms influencing resource allocation, social rating, or news feeds have Open Source source code.
requirements.gap: The document does not define influence coverage or qualifying Open Source conditions. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define influence tracing and the Open Source acceptance rule.

requirements.title: Personal Assets Are Inheritable
requirements.quote: 16.1. Personal assets are heritable.
requirements.interpretation: Check that personal assets are eligible for inheritance. This general permission requires reconciliation with the ultra-large-fortune transfer rule in the same clause.
requirements.criterion: Personal assets are eligible for inheritance.
requirements.gap: Personal-asset classification and precedence of the ultra-large-fortune rule are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define personal assets and interaction with mandatory fortune transfers.

requirements.title: Infrastructure And Power Cannot Be Inherited
requirements.quote: Infrastructure capital and power are not subject to inheritance.
requirements.interpretation: Check that inheritance transfers exclude infrastructure capital and power. The categories and treatment of indirect ownership or control are undefined.
requirements.criterion: No infrastructure capital or power is inherited.
requirements.gap: Infrastructure capital and power are not operationally defined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define prohibited asset and control categories, including indirect transfers.

requirements.title: Ultra Large Fortunes Revert At Death
requirements.quote: Ultra-large fortunes return to the Global Development Fund after the owner's death.
requirements.interpretation: Check mandatory transfer to the Global Development Fund after an eligible owner's death. The fortune threshold, transferred portion, and transfer deadline are missing.
requirements.criterion: After the owner's death, an ultra-large fortune returns to the Global Development Fund.
requirements.gap: Ultra-large eligibility, transfer scope, and timing are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define the fortune threshold, whether the whole fortune transfers, and the transfer deadline.

requirements.title: Universal Survival Resource Entitlement
requirements.quote: 17.1. Every human is guaranteed a minimum set of resources for survival (food, shelter, connectivity) by right of birth.
requirements.interpretation: Check that every human has a birth-based entitlement covering food, shelter, and connectivity. Resource quantities and whether the guarantee requires actual delivery are not specified.
requirements.criterion: Every human has a right by birth to minimum survival resources including food, shelter, and connectivity.
requirements.gap: Minimum resource levels and the operational meaning of guaranteed provision are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define minimum levels and whether entitlement, availability, or delivery satisfies the guarantee.

requirements.title: UBR Receipt Requires Social Participation
requirements.quote: 18.1. Receipt of UBR imposes an obligation to participate in education, creativity, or socially useful activity.
requirements.interpretation: Check that UBR recipients participate in at least one listed category. Participation sufficiency, assessment period, and exemptions are not defined.
requirements.criterion: A UBR recipient participates in education, creativity, or socially useful activity.
requirements.gap: Qualifying activity and sufficient participation over time are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define activity eligibility, participation requirements, and assessment periods.

requirements.title: Total Passivity Reduces Benefit Rating
requirements.quote: Total passivity leads to a reduced rating for access to additional benefits.
requirements.interpretation: Check a downward rating transition after total passivity is determined. The text specifies reduced access rating for additional benefits, without specifying removal of UBR.
requirements.criterion: Total passivity causes a reduction in the rating used for access to additional benefits.
requirements.gap: Total passivity, assessment duration, and rating reduction magnitude are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define total passivity and the rating reduction rule.

requirements.title: Continuous Civilization Motion Inequality
requirements.quote:
At any moment in time *t*, the Network must maintain:
dW/dt ≥ k · E(t) · T(t) · B(t)2.83
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate the inequality over time using a declared continuous model or numerical approximation. W, E, and T are described but not given complete measurement or aggregation functions.
requirements.criterion: At every time t, dW/dt ≥ k · E(t) · T(t) · B(t)^2.83.
requirements.gap: Operational variable definitions and a method for checking the derivative at every moment are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define W, E, and the energy-and-compute logarithm used for T.
Declare time units, interpolation, and derivative estimation.

requirements.title: Physical Truth Biosphere Index Bounds

requirements.criterion: Proof-of-Synergy validates blocks based on proven contribution to reducing system entropy, including biosphere restoration, social stability, or technological efficiency, rather than electricity burning or capital accumulation.
requirements.gap: Contribution valuation, entropy reduction, proof validation, and consensus rules are absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define contribution evidence and entropy reduction.
Declare how validated contributions determine block acceptance.

requirements.title: Verified Hardware Direct Blockchain Reporting
requirements.quote: A network of verified hardware oracles (satellites, sensors, IoT) that transmit data about the physical world's state (temperature, CO2, sea level) directly to the blockchain.
requirements.interpretation: Check hardware verification and direct blockchain transmission of physical-state observations. 'Verified' and 'directly' are not technically defined, and the subsequent claim that falsification is impossible lacks a threat model.
requirements.criterion: Physical Truth Layer hardware oracles are verified and transmit physical-state observations directly to the blockchain.
requirements.gap: Hardware verification and direct-transmission acceptance criteria are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define accepted hardware verification and allowable transmission intermediaries.

requirements.title: Peace Collateral And Violation Remedies
requirements.quote: - Peace Staking: An economic collateral mechanism where assets are "frozen" not for passive income, but as a guarantee of non-aggression and Code compliance. In case of violation (aggression or ecocide), the stake is automatically burned or redistributed to repair damage.
requirements.interpretation: Check that Peace Stakes are frozen as compliance collateral and automatically burned or redistributed after aggression or ecocide. The glossary adds ecocide and a redistribution alternative to Article 7's aggression-and-burning rule; it does not necessarily prohibit the dividends expressly allowed in 7.2.
requirements.criterion: Peace Stakes are frozen to guarantee non-aggression and Code compliance; aggression or ecocide triggers automatic burning or redistribution to repair damage.
requirements.gap: Ecocide, the scope of other Code violations, and selection between burning and redistribution are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define ecocide and qualifying violations.
Resolve remedy selection and its relationship to Article 7.

requirements.title: Independent Fully Compliant Wild Node
requirements.quote: - Wild Node: A network node launched by an independent party (city, corporation, or community) without prior coordination with the founders, but in full compliance with the protocol.
requirements.interpretation: Check independent launch, absence of prior founder coordination, and complete protocol compliance. This general definition does not itself repeat A.5's twenty-four-month condition and is broader than the signature-slot annotation.
requirements.criterion: A Wild Node is launched by an independent party without prior founder coordination and fully complies with the protocol.
requirements.gap: Independence, prior coordination, and full protocol compliance are not operationally defined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Define independence, prohibited coordination, and full compliance.
Distinguish general Wild Node status from startup and signature-slot eligibility.

requirements.title: Immutable Message Cryptographic Preservation
requirements.quote: - Immutable Message: A text message cryptographically embedded in the Genesis Block code. It is the philosophical manifesto and "constitution" of the system, which is technically impossible to delete or edit as long as the network exists.
requirements.interpretation: Check cryptographic embedding and prove that no permitted network transition can delete or edit the message while the network exists. This adds a technical impossibility requirement to the annotation's permanent-embedding rule.
requirements.criterion: The Immutable Message is cryptographically embedded in Genesis and cannot be deleted or edited while the network exists.
requirements.gap: Cryptographic construction and the complete model needed to establish impossibility are absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare cryptographic assumptions, allowed transitions, and network existence conditions.
